# Setup

```{r setup}
#| output: false
here::i_am("building_models/07_full_models.qmd")
source(here::here("R", "data_import_and_cleaning.R"))
source(here::here("R", "func_prep_data.R"))

library(gfoRmula)
library(gFormulaMI)
library(magrittr)
library(SPHSUgraphs)
library(tidyverse)
library(data.table)

pop_data <- import_data() |> 
  select(-econ_incquint) 

ggplot2::theme_set(theme_sphsu_light())

# Filter for only those observed at wave 2 (baseline), and wave 6

pop_dt <- pop_data |> 
  filter(wave == 2, response == 1) |> 
  select(pidp) |> 
  left_join(pop_data, by = "pidp") |> 
  filter(wave == 6, response == 1) |> 
  select(pidp) |> 
  left_join(pop_data, by = "pidp") |> 
  filter(!is.na(mastat_dv_base)) |> 
  mutate(dnc = factor(dnc) |> fct_collapse(zero = "0", one = "1", other_level = "2+")) |> 
  data.table::as.data.table()

long_data <- pop_dt[, `:=`(
  t0 = t0 - 2,
  pre_mcs = shift(sf12mcs_dv, type = "lag"),
  pre_pcs = shift(sf12pcs_dv, type = "lag"),
  mcs_outcome = sf12mcs_dv,
  pcs_outcome = sf12pcs_dv
)][wave %in% 3:6]

no_mh_outcomes <- long_data |> 
  group_by(pidp) |> 
  summarise(n_missing = sum(is.na(sf12mcs_dv)), base_missing = all(is.na(sf12mcs_dv_base))) |> 
  filter(n_missing == 2, base_missing) |> 
  select(pidp) |> 
  as.data.table()

long_data <- long_data[!no_mh_outcomes, on = .(pidp)] 

intervention_pattern_2 <- expand_grid(0:1, 0:1) |>
  t() |>
  as_tibble(.name_repair = "minimal") |>
  unclass()

intervention_pattern_3 <- expand_grid(0:1, 0:1, 0:1) |>
  t() |>
  as_tibble(.name_repair = "minimal") |>
  unclass()

intervention_pattern_4 <- expand_grid(0:1, 0:1, 0:1, 0:1) |>
  t() |>
  as_tibble(.name_repair = "minimal") |>
  unclass()

ncores <- 2

nsamples <- 100

# Setup wide data for MI

wide_data <- long_data |>
  mutate(econ_emp_bin = as_factor(econ_emp_bin)) |> 
  make_wide(
    pidp,
    t0,
    base_cols = c(sex_dv_base,
                  wnw_race_base,
                  hiqual_dv_base,
                  age_dv_base,
                  gor_dv_base,
                  mastat_dv_base,
                  sf12mcs_dv_base),
    outcome = sf12mcs_dv,
    sf12pcs_dv,
    econ_dist,
    dnc,
    econ_benefits,
    home_owner,
    econ_emp_bin,
    log_income,
    sf12mcs_dv
  )

# wide_mids <- mice::mice(wide_data, defaultMethod = c("norm", "logreg", "pmm", "pmm"), m = 35, maxit = 10)
wide_mids <- readRDS(here::here("data", "wide_mids.rds"))

missing_data <- long_data |>
  filter(
    is.na(pidp) |
    is.na(t0) |
    is.na(mcs_outcome) |
    is.na(pcs_outcome) |
    is.na(sex_dv_base) |
    is.na(wnw_race_base) |
    is.na(hiqual_dv_base) |
    is.na(age_dv_base) |
    is.na(gor_dv_base) |
    is.na(mastat_dv_base) |
    is.na(sf12mcs_dv_base) |
    is.na(sf12pcs_dv) |
    is.na(econ_dist) |
    is.na(dnc) |
    is.na(econ_benefits) |
    is.na(home_owner) |
    is.na(econ_emp_bin) |
    is.na(log_income) |
    is.na(sf12mcs_dv)
    ) |> 
  pull(pidp)

full_pop <- long_data |> 
  filter(!(pidp %in% missing_data))

base_predictor_matrix <- make_predictor_matrix(wide_data)
```



# Three periods of intervention

## gformula

```{r 3dynamic-gform}
outcome_type <- "continuous_eof"
outcome_name <- "sf12mcs_dv"
intvars <- c("econ_emp_bin")



covnames <-
  c(
    "sf12pcs_dv",
    "econ_emp_bin",
    "econ_dist",
    "dnc",
    "econ_benefits",
    "home_owner",
    "log_income",
    "sf12mcs_dv"
  )


covtypes <- c(
  "normal", # pre_pcs
  "binary", # econ_emp_bin
  "categorical", # econ_dist
  "categorical", # dnc
  "categorical", # econ_benefits
  "categorical", # home_owner
  "normal", # log_income
  "normal" # pre_mc
)

basecovs <- c(
  "sex_dv_base",
  "gor_dv_base",
  "wnw_race_base",
  "hiqual_dv_base",
  "age_dv_base",
  "mastat_dv_base"
  # "dnc_base",
  # "mastat_dv_base",
)

ymodel <- sf12mcs_dv ~ sex_dv_base + gor_dv_base + wnw_race_base + hiqual_dv_base + age_dv_base +
  mastat_dv_base +  # Baseline - sex
  lag1_sf12mcs_dv + sf12pcs_dv + econ_dist + dnc + econ_benefits + home_owner +     # Time-varying confounders
  econ_emp_bin + log_income    # Time-varying exposures


covparams <- list(
  covmodels = c(
    sf12pcs_dv ~ sex_dv_base + gor_dv_base + wnw_race_base + hiqual_dv_base + age_dv_base +
      lag1_sf12pcs_dv + lag1_sf12mcs_dv + lag1_econ_dist + lag1_dnc + lag1_econ_benefits + lag1_home_owner +
      lag1_econ_emp_bin + lag1_log_income,
    econ_emp_bin ~ sex_dv_base + gor_dv_base + wnw_race_base + hiqual_dv_base + age_dv_base +
      lag1_sf12mcs_dv + sf12pcs_dv + lag1_econ_dist + lag1_dnc + lag1_econ_benefits + lag1_home_owner + lag1_log_income + lag1_econ_emp_bin,
    econ_dist ~ sex_dv_base + gor_dv_base + wnw_race_base + hiqual_dv_base + age_dv_base +
      lag1_sf12mcs_dv + sf12pcs_dv + lag1_econ_dist + lag1_dnc + lag1_econ_benefits + lag1_home_owner +
      econ_emp_bin + lag1_log_income,
    dnc ~ sex_dv_base + gor_dv_base + wnw_race_base + hiqual_dv_base + age_dv_base +
      lag1_sf12mcs_dv + sf12pcs_dv + econ_dist + lag1_dnc + lag1_econ_benefits + lag1_home_owner + econ_emp_bin + lag1_log_income,
    econ_benefits ~ sex_dv_base + gor_dv_base + wnw_race_base + hiqual_dv_base + age_dv_base +
      lag1_sf12mcs_dv + sf12pcs_dv + lag1_econ_dist + dnc + lag1_econ_benefits + lag1_home_owner +
      econ_emp_bin + lag1_log_income,
    home_owner ~ sex_dv_base + gor_dv_base + wnw_race_base + hiqual_dv_base + age_dv_base +
      lag1_sf12mcs_dv + sf12pcs_dv + econ_dist + dnc + econ_benefits + lag1_home_owner +
      econ_emp_bin + lag1_log_income,
    log_income ~
      sex_dv_base + gor_dv_base + wnw_race_base + hiqual_dv_base + age_dv_base +
      lag1_log_income + sf12pcs_dv + lag1_sf12mcs_dv + econ_dist + dnc + econ_benefits + home_owner + econ_emp_bin,
    sf12mcs_dv ~ sex_dv_base + gor_dv_base + wnw_race_base + hiqual_dv_base + age_dv_base +
      lag1_sf12mcs_dv + sf12pcs_dv + lag1_econ_dist + lag1_dnc + lag1_econ_benefits + lag1_home_owner +
      lag1_econ_emp_bin + lag1_log_income
  )
)






lagged_variables <- c(
  "sf12pcs_dv",
  "sf12mcs_dv",
  "econ_dist",
  "dnc",
  "home_owner",
  "econ_benefits",
  "econ_emp_bin",
  "log_income"
)


histories <- c(lagged)
histvars <- list(lagged_variables)



interventions <- intervention_pattern_3 |>
  map(~ list(c(set_n_periods, NA_integer_, .x)))

intvars <- as.list(rep("econ_emp_bin", length(interventions)))

int_description <-
  map(
    interventions,
    ~ paste(.x[[1]][-1], collapse = "-") |>
      str_remove_all("NA-") |>
      paste0("econ_emp_bin:", x = _)
  )


gform_cont_eof <- gformula(
  obs_data = full_pop,
  outcome_type = outcome_type,
  id = "pidp",
  time_name = "t0",
  # time_points = time_points,
  covnames = covnames,
  outcome_name = outcome_name,
  covtypes = covtypes,
  covparams = covparams,
  ymodel = ymodel,
  
  intvars = intvars,
  interventions = interventions,
  int_descript = int_description,
  
  
  histories = histories,
  histvars = histvars,
  basecovs = basecovs,
  seed = 4321,
  parallel = FALSE,
  # nsamples = nsamples,
  # ncores = ncores,
  ref_int = 1
)
    

gform_cont_eof$result |> 
  select(estimate = `g-form mean`) |> 
  mutate(intervention = c("Baseline", intervention_pattern_3 |> map_chr(~paste(.x, collapse = "-")))) |> 
    ggplot(aes(estimate, intervention)) +
    geom_point(size = 3)  +
  scale_colour_sphsu()
# gform_2dynamic <- pool_gform_estimates(gform_long)
```
 
## gFormulaMI

```{r 3dynamic-mi}
regimes <- intervention_pattern_3

predictor_matrix <- base_predictor_matrix

predictor_matrix["sf12mcs_dv_base",] <- 0
predictor_matrix[,"sf12mcs_dv_base"] <- 0

imps <- gFormulaImpute(
  wide_mids,
  trtVars = c("econ_emp_bin_1", "econ_emp_bin_2", "econ_emp_bin_3"),
  trtRegimes = regimes,
  predictorMatrix = predictor_matrix
)

fits <- imps %$%
  lm(sf12mcs_dv_3 ~ 0 + factor(regime))

mi_3dynamic <- syntheticPool(fits)

regimes_3 <- tibble(intervention = regimes |> 
  map(paste, collapse = "-") |> 
  reduce(c)
)
```

## Comparing results

```{r 3dynamic-tab}
#| output: true
mod_3dynamic <- mi_3dynamic |>
  as_tibble() |>
  rownames_to_column("Intervention") |>
  transmute(mi_effect = Estimate,
            mi_se = sqrt(Total),
            mi_ll = `95% CI L`,
            mi_ul = `95% CI U`) |>
  # bind_cols(
    # gform_3dynamic |> filter(interv != 0) |> select(-interv)
  # ) |>
  bind_cols(regimes_3)

mod_3dynamic |> 
  knitr::kable(digits = 3)
  
```

```{r 3dynamic-graph}
#| output: true
mod_3dynamic |>
  pivot_longer(
    -intervention,
    names_to = c("Calculation method", ".value"),
    names_pattern = "(.*)_(.*)"
  ) |>
  mutate(n_unemp = map_int(intervention, ~ length(str_extract_all(.x, "1", simplify = TRUE))) |>
           factor()) |> 
ggplot(aes(effect, intervention, shape = `Calculation method`, xmin = ll, xmax = ul,
    colour = n_unemp)) +
  geom_point(size = 2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7))  +
  geom_errorbar(width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  scale_colour_brewer(name = "Number of unemployed periods", palette = "Set1") +
  facet_wrap(~`Calculation method`, ncol = 1)
```
